missing_metadata: Original response rows and start event have no hardware_context field.
Request sampling settings are recovered from the runner protocol, not per-response settings records.
Original start command has no explicit cache-ram cap; do not attribute the later 256 MiB fix to this run.

policy: All 100 raw completion responses were read in full against the fixed prompts and report.md's strict binary policy.
The whole returned text is assessed, including text before stray think markers; this differs from the separate chat judges final-only policy.
core_answer_correct records the correct central numeric/factual result even when a wrong explicit option letter, incorrect supporting explanation or missing requested check prevents strict_pass.
strict_pass requires the correct answer and all substantive requested calculation/explanation/check components, without unresolved contradictions.
A uniquely correct option value with valid working can pass without a letter, flagged missing_option_letter. An explicitly wrong option letter always fails strict_pass.
Genuine self-correction is accepted. An unfinished trailing sentence or token cap does not fail an already complete and correct response by itself.
A requested check must verify the result by a sum, inverse operation, substitution or independent computation. Restating or repeating the same calculation labelled Check is insufficient.
Word-limit and one-sentence formatting problems are reported separately and do not by themselves fail the substantive strict score.
These are provisional local manual assessments, not ARC-Easy results or official panel scores.

original_option_parser.scope: Stored historical correct fields for the 50 MC responses, not recomputed or used for manual grading.
